t.0: 1. بَابُ الْحَثِّ عَلَى ذِكْرِ اللهِ تَعَالَى
t.1: 2. بَابٌ فِي أَسْمَاءِ اللهِ تَعَالَى وَفَضْلِ مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا
t.2: 3. بَابُ الْعَزْمِ بِالدُّعَاءِ وَلَا يَقُلْ إِنْ شِئْتَ
t.3: 4. بَابُ كَرَاهَةِ تَمَنِّي الْمَوْتِ لِضُرٍّ نَزَلَ بِهِ
t.4: 5. بَابُ مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللهِ أَحَبَّ اللهُ لِقَاءَهُ وَمَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللهِ كَرِهَ اللهُ لِقَاءَهُ
t.5: 6. بَابُ فَضْلِ الذِّكْرِ وَالدُّعَاءِ وَالتَّقَرُّبِ إِلَى اللهِ تَعَالَى
t.6: 7. بَابُ كَرَاهَةِ الدُّعَاءِ بِتَعْجِيلِ الْعُقُوبَةِ فِي الدُّنْيَا
t.8: 9. بَابُ فَضْلِ الدُّعَاءِ بِاللهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
t.24: 14. بَابُ التَّعَوُّذِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْفِتَنِ وَغَيْرِهَا
t.25: 15. بَابُ التَّعَوُّذِ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَغَيْرِهِ
t.26: 16. بَابٌ فِي التَّعَوُّذِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِ
t.27: 17. بَابُ مَا يَقُولُ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ وَأَخْذِ الْمَضْجَعِ
t.42: 19. بَابُ التَّسْبِيحِ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ وَعِنْدَ النَّوْمِ
t.43: 20. بَابُ اسْتِحْبَابِ الدُّعَاءِ عِنْدَ صِيَاحِ الدِّيكِ
t.46: 23. بَابُ فَضْلِ الدُّعَاءِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ
t.48: 25. بَابُ بَيَانِ أَنَّهُ يُسْتَجَابُ لِلدَّاعِي مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ: دَعَوْتُ فَلَمْ يُسْتَجَبْ لِي
t.49: 26. بَابُ أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
t.50: 27. بَابُ قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْغَارِ الثَّلَاثَةِ وَالتَّوَسُّلِ بِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ

x.9: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who recites in the morning and in the evening (these words): " Hallowed be Allah and all praise is due to Him" one hundred times, he would not bring on the Day of Resurrection anything excellent than this except one who utters these words or utters more than these words
x.10: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The uttering of (these words): " Hallowed be Allah; all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest," is dearer to me than anything over which the sun rises
x.19: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who alleviates the suffering of a brother out of the sufferings of the world, Allah would alleviate his suffering from the sufferings of the Day of Resurrection, and he who finds relief for one who is hard-pressed, Allah would make things easy for him in the Hereafter, and he who conceals (the faults) of a Muslim, Allah would conceal his faults in the world and in the Hereafter. Allah is at the back of a servant so long as the servant is at the back of his brother, and he who treads the path in search of knowledge, Allah would make that path easy, leading to Paradise for him and those persons who assemble in the house among the houses of Allah (mosques) and recite the Book of Allah and they learn and teach the Qur'an (among themselves) there would descend upon them tranquility and mercy would cover them and the angels would surround them and Allah mentions them in the presence of those near Him, and he who is slow-paced in doing good deeds, his (high) lineage does not make him go ahead
x.20: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
x.47: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking
